item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi phyag bzhes nyi ma'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi lag len nyi ma'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba / bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan chen po gshen chen po gtsug phud 'od zer gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i gshen gyi btsun pa rnam dag 'od zer gyis khri brten nor bu rtse nas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel
item.note: ytkc has a title phyag len nyi ma'i 'khor lo. on a person who might be our author, see dpal-tshul, history (tbmc edition), vol. 2, p. 403, line 5. a few works by one mkhas-grub rnam-dag 'od-zer have been published (karmay, catalogue, pp. 27, 56, 71). in the colophon, the author pays homage to his teacher, gshen chen-po gtsug-phud 'od-zer. compare the colophons of 37.7 and 37.12, below.
